popCulture.title: Venus and Adonis
popCulture.creator: William Shakespeare
popCulture.description: Shakespeare's narrative poem made Adonis the reluctant beloved of Venus — the boar's victim as Elizabethan erotic elegy.

popCulture.title: Adonis
popCulture.description: English still calls a strikingly handsome man an Adonis — the dying beloved turned into a compliment.

popCulture.title: Adonis (plant)
popCulture.description: The anemone-like Adonis flower keeps his blood in the spring garden — the youth's wound as a genus of buttercups.
